items.title: The Chicago Bulls started the season with a record of 1-8 while shooting 27.6% on 3-pointers.
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
The Chicago Bulls started the season with a record of 1-8 while shooting 27.6% on 3-pointers.

Since then, the Bulls have shot 135 / 330 | 40.9% from three with a record of 4-4 over that span.

In the last eight games they improved their season 3p% from 27.6% —> 34.1%

quote.author: Hoop Informatics
quote.text:
34.1% = league worst team 3p% last season (Brooklyn Nets) 

27.6% = Chicago Bulls current 3p% this season. 

Cleaningtheglass.com

items.title: November 24, 1984: Chicago rookie Michael Jordan with a driving up-and-under move in Portland.
items.author: NBA Cobwebs
items.body_excerpt:
November 24, 1984: Chicago rookie Michael Jordan with a driving up-and-under move in Portland.

Jordan had 30 PTS/8 AST/6 REB/3 STL but the Bulls fell to the Trail Blazers, 141-131. Jim Paxson scored 31 PTS (14-18 FG) and Kiki Vandeweghe scored 30 PTS (12-16 FG) for the Blazers.
